_readme: Edit the values below, then commit the change. No coding needed — you can edit this file right in the GitHub website. Note: your ntfy topic name is NOT set here — it lives in a repo Secret instead, so it stays hidden even though this file (and this repo) is public.
_lead_times_note: Lead-time reminders (3 hours / 24 hours before launch) are no longer set here — they're fixed in notifier.py as OFFERED_LEAD_TIMES_HOURS, since visitors pick their own lead time on the dashboard by choosing which ntfy sub-topic to subscribe to (e.g. CoolRockets-3h vs CoolRockets-24h).
_rocket_keywords_help: Only launches whose rocket name contains one of these words get notifications. Set to [] (empty) to get notified about every launch on the site, not just SpaceX.
_notify_on_new_launch_added_help: If true, subscribers to the base topic get a one-time notification whenever a brand new launch first appears on the schedule.
_notify_on_time_change_help: If true, subscribers to the base topic get notified when a launch gets delayed or moved to a new date/time.
